HowItWorks.title: The GAF Process
HowItWorks.subtitle: How we convert disorganized public grievances into structured, actionable intelligence.
HowItWorks.step1Desc: Citizens securely register their issues through our platform. Data is encrypted and mapped to specific geographic coordinates.
HowItWorks.step2Desc: Our intelligence engine automatically categorizes issues by sector, urgency, and pattern clustering.
HowItWorks.step3Desc: Subject matter experts and regional coordinators review clustered issues to formulate intervention strategies.
HowItWorks.step4Desc: Data is presented to the leadership network for definitive public action and continuous tracking until resolved.
